artworks.title: The Martyrdom of Saint Barbara
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of medieval figures and a tree. The image depicts a dense gathering of figures, all wearing elaborate period costumes, including helmets, robes, and armor. Their expressions vary. At the top, a leafy tree dominates the background alongside swirling clouds. The foreground hints at an interaction among the individuals, possibly a scene of discourse or judgment. Several personal items and tools are on the ground. The attention to detail and the use of line to create intricate patterns and textures are notable features of this work. This is in the style of Albrecht Dürer.

artworks.title: John William, Duke of Saxe-Coburg
artworks.description: This print shows a man standing, facing slightly to the right, his head turning to look at us. His left arm is crossed over his body, resting on a thin sword that hangs on his left side, while his right hand is near his chest. He has pale skin, a small mustache, thin eyebrows, a long nose, and a small mouth set in a slight smile. He wears a feathered beret that covers the top of his head. He is dressed in a wide, fur-lined cloak with several layers of ruffles, a doublet, and puffed sleeves, with several chains hanging down his neck below a frilled collar. These thick clothes make his torso and upper body look very wide. On his legs, he wears short pants that end slightly below the edge of his cloak, and the rest of his legs seem to be covered by thin tights. The background behind him and ground below him are both plain beige paper, separated by a black horizontal line. The man casts a faint shadow on the ground.

artworks.title: Saint Anne and the Virgin with the Child
artworks.description: The image shows two women holding an infant. The woman on the left is slightly hunched over and holding the child with her arms wrapped around it, while the woman on the right stands close by, also supporting the child with her arms. The woman on the left appears to have her hair covered by a headdress, whereas the woman on the right has long, flowing and curly hair. Both women wear flowing garments that drape down to their feet. The infant they are holding is small and is swaddled in cloth. A crowned figure above them is intersected by radiant beams of light, holding a book and a staff, with cherubic figures surrounding the composition. The background is filled with cloud formations.

artworks.title: The Second Tournament with the Tapestry of Samson and the Lion
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a jousting tournament. It shows armored knights on horseback engaged in a jousting competition. The knights wear detailed suits of armor and helmets, and the horses are adorned with decorative coverings. Lances are the primary weapons used in the joust. In the background, a crowd of spectators watches from a raised platform. The scene is filled with intricate details of medieval tournament culture.

artworks.title: The Third Tournament
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a medieval jousting scene. The scene shows mounted knights engaging in combat with lances, in an organized but chaotic melee. The knights are wearing armor and their horses are also protected. The setting seems to be an arena, with spectators watching from an elevated structure in the background. The drawing captures the energetic and dynamic movement of the knights and horses. The focus is on the detailing of the armor and the composition to create depth and action.

artworks.title: Hunter on Horseback Hunting a Wild Boar
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a hunting scene in a dense forest. The drawing depicts a forest with tall, slender trees in the background and detailed branches and leaves. The foreground shows an interaction between animals and a figure on a horse. The figure is wearing period attire and is engaged with two wild boars. One of the boars appears to charge towards the figure. The drawing's line work captures textures of the animals' fur and the forest's foliage. The style and technique resemble the craftsmanship of a woodcut or engraving.

artworks.title: The Ecstasy of Saint Mary Magdalene
artworks.description: This is a drawing of celestial figures above a landscape. The drawing is detailed and features intricate lines and shading. The composition includes a central ascending figure surrounded by smaller winged figures. In the background, there are buildings, trees, and rolling hills. The artwork includes heraldic symbols in the top corners. The figures have classical features and flowing drapery reminiscent of Renaissance art.

artworks.title: Saint Luke
artworks.description: The image shows a seated man at a desk, writing with a quill in his right hand and resting his left hand on an open book. A radiant halo surrounds his head. He has a face with a serene expression, wearing a cap, and a robe with voluminous sleeves. In front of him is a winged ox on a tiled floor. Next to him is a decorative desk with intricate patterns. The background features a wall with a window looking out onto a pastoral scene, an image of a woman and child surrounded by clouds, and an ornamental tapestry partially visible to the left.

artworks.title: The Penitence of Saint Jerome
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed landscape with a central tall tree. Near the base of the tree, a man is kneeling next to a lion. The horizon line is low, emphasizing swirling clouds and textured tree branches. In the distance, there is a structure resembling a small chapel among dense trees. The artist's fine lines detail the bark, lion's fur, and foliage. The monochromatic color palette relies on light and dark contrast to convey depth and texture.

artworks.title: Saint George Standing, with Two Angels
artworks.description: This print shows a full-body depiction of a knight standing upright, facing the left. The knight has a solemn expression and curly, short hair. He is wearing a detailed suit of armor and is holding a large staff or banner near the left side of the print, while his other hand rests near his waist, on the hilt of a long sword. Two small cherubic figures stand on either side of him, one holding a large, plumed helmet, and the other appearing to hold another piece of armor. Behind the feet of the knight, on the ground, the face of a wolf-like animal is partially visible. The ground is rocky, and the background features a landscape with a castle on a hill in the top right corner. Small people, including another knight, roam around the trees and other small buildings scattered across the rolling hills. The sky is clear, and two symbols that look like crests or coats of arms float on either side of the knight's head, which is surrounded by an ornate halo.

artworks.title: Saint George and the Dragon
artworks.description: A drawing of a knight on horseback triumphing over a dragon. The scene shows a heavily armored knight riding a rearing horse, brandishing a sword at a defeated dragon lying on the ground. Beside them, a distressed maiden is present. The background includes gnarled trees with twisted branches, bones, and coats of arms hanging from branches. The drawing is detailed, focusing on line work and shading to depict the tension of the encounter. Below the image is Latin text.

artworks.title: Saint Christopher
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut printed in brown-orange and black
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a wilderness setting by a river. The scene features rocky cliffs, lush vegetation, a large bearded figure holding a staff, and a small cherubic figure beside them. In the background, there is a village against a mountainous backdrop. The drawing has rich texture and intricate details, with a contrast of dark lines and lighter hues.

artworks.title: Saint Bernard Adoring the Man of Sorrows
artworks.description: There is an image of two figures. One figure is seated on the left while the other stands on the right. The seated figure is displayed from the knees up, with his head slightly bowed and turned to the right. He has a beard, curly hair partially covered by a crown of thorns, and a solemn expression. Rays are emanating from his head, and he is bare-chested with a cloth wrapped around his waist. His hands are crossed over his lap with visible marks on them. The standing figure faces the seated one, with hands raised and clasped together. This figure has short hair, a high forehead, and wears a robe. An ornate hat resembling a papal tiara is on the ground between them. Above them are stylized clouds with small birds and symbols. The background is plain, emphasizing the interaction between the two figures.

artworks.title: Saint Barbara
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing, slightly turned to the right. Her head is tilted downwards, with her eyes gazing ahead. The woman has delicate facial features with high cheekbones, and her hair is styled elaborately, featuring long, curling strands cascading down from both sides of her face. She is dressed in ornately patterned attire, with a fitted bodice and a long, flowing skirt. On her upper sleeves are intricate designs, while the lower part of the garment is voluminous and gathered. The woman holds a chalice delicately with both hands. Surrounding her is a landscape with a rocky terrain, sparse vegetation, and a castle in the distance. The sky is filled with swirling clouds, within which are faces suggesting wind or celestial figures.

artworks.title: The Temptation of Saint Anthony
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to image): 40.3 x 27.7 cm (15 7/8 x 10 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a mix of creatures and a landscape. The upper portion shows mythical beings and creatures with unique features engaged in interactions, conveying movement and turmoil. The lower portion depicts a detailed landscape with a town, hills, and a river, offering a serene backdrop. The style is reminiscent of Albrecht Dürer's work known for blending fantastical elements with detailed realism.

artworks.title: Saint Philip
artworks.description: This is a medieval execution scene. An individual tied to a wooden beam is held aloft by two smaller beams, with his hands extended to either side. Armored figures and mounted soldiers surround the scene. The soldiers are equipped with spears and other weapons, some are on horseback. In the background, there are hills, fortress-like structures, and banners or crests. The clothing and armor are detailed and the composition is well-organized.

artworks.title: Saint Matthew
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a historical scene involving horses and figures. The drawing shows intricately dressed individuals, some on horseback, surrounded by armed individuals with polearms and swords. The participants are in conversation or discourse along a path. Animals are visible in the foreground, and there are landscape elements like grasses and clouds in the background.

artworks.title: Saint Simon
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a skinned body hanging from a crossbar with various figures and objects around it. The monochrome ink illustration shows detailed scene with a skinned body hanging on a horizontal beam supported by two upright logs. In the foreground, there are two shields with coats of arms and different textures are depicted with fine lines. There are several horses present, one on the front right is elaborately adorned with a cloth. A group of figures surrounding the hanging body is engaged in various activities. The background shows mountainous terrain with a structure perched atop it. At the bottom of the image lies what seems to be another skinned animal. The use of cross-hatching and contrast creates a well-defined composition typical of early European woodcuts or line engravings.

artworks.title: Saint Jude
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures gathered under an ornately decorated throne. The drawing is intricately detailed in black and white, featuring a group of figures gathered in a semi-circular formation beneath a raised, canopied structure. The figures are elaborately dressed with headgear and cloaks. Above them is a throne-like seat, ornately designed with an inscribed panel and decorative flourishes. The use of line and shading creates a dramatic composition, emphasizing the expressions and postures of the figures.

artworks.title: Saint Matthias
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a medieval scene at a city gate. The image features a large group of armed men on horseback and on foot gathered near a tall, wooden city gate. Some are holding spears or halberds. The foreground includes a pile of garments, and the background shows a fortified building with a cylindrical tower on a hill. Two heraldic shields are visible above the crowd. The style of the drawing is detailed, resembling a woodcut or etching.

artworks.title: Saint James the Greater
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with knights and heraldry. The drawing depicts an arranged group of armored figures, some on horseback and others standing, encircling a central character who is kneeling. This scene is detailed with ornate armor, and the figures hold tall spears or lances. The background displays a barren tree with bare branches. On the top right, there are coat of arms visible. The intricate lines and textures convey a sense of movement and historical context.

artworks.title: Saint Bartholomew
artworks.description: This is a black-and-white woodcut-style drawing of a figure being tortured on a rack. The scene includes a group of figures in armor and others engaging in the act of torture in an outdoor environment. In the center, a figure is tied to a large wooden device resembling a rack with ropes extending in different directions. Surrounding figures appear focused on operating the device, while others observe. The background includes a wall, foliage, and a building facade, suggesting an enclosed area. The drawing is detailed with heavy use of lines and shading, typical of historical illustrations in classical or medieval themed artworks.

artworks.title: Saint John the Evangelist
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people gathered around an altar. The scene depicts numerous figures congregated around the altar. One figure kneels in front of the altar, holding what appears to be a book or script. The background includes a large candle and ornate decorations on the altar. The drawing features fine, intricate line work and a richly detailed interior setting with a sense of quiet reverence.

artworks.title: Saint Thomas
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with multiple figures in a dramatic interaction. The scene shows individuals in an interior space with architectural elements like a window and a large candle holder or chandelier. On the right, a figure appears to be restrained near a post. The artwork is detailed with lines accentuating the characters' expressions and clothing textures. Light and shadow are depicted with hatching, giving the piece depth and formality.
